description: This PHP class 'FilterInterpreter' interprets filter structures for the SuiteCRM JSON API, converting them into SQL clauses or filter objects, and handles various filter types including pre-made filters, ID filters, and attribute-based filters. It also manages operators and custom fields.

classes.name: FilterInterpreter
classes.description: Interprets filter structures for SuiteCRM's JSON API, converting them into SQL or filter objects, managing operators, and handling custom fields.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the FilterInterpreter with dependency injection container, setting up operators and interpreters.

methods.name: isFilterByPreMadeName
methods.description: Checks if the filter structure corresponds to a pre-made filter by name.

methods.name: isFilterById
methods.description: Checks if the filter structure is an ID filter.

methods.name: isFilterByAttributes
methods.description: Checks if the filter structure is attribute-based.

methods.name: getFilterByPreMadeName
methods.description: Converts a pre-made filter name into an SQL clause.

methods.name: getFilterById
methods.description: Converts an ID filter structure into a filter object.

methods.name: getFilterByAttributes
methods.description: Converts attribute filters into an SQL WHERE clause.

methods.name: toSqlFilter
methods.description: Builds an SQL filter string for a specific field and operator.

methods.name: getOperator
methods.description: Retrieves the operator object matching a given operator string.

methods.name: isCustomField
methods.description: Checks if a field is a custom field for a given module.

methods.name: toCustomTable
methods.description: Converts a table name to its custom version (appends '_cstm' if not present).
